title: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
description: A velvety pantry tomato soup that begs for a grilled cheese on the side.

items: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook 6–8 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, the broth and sugar. Bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered for 20 minutes.
Remove from the heat, add the basil and blend until smooth with an immersion blender.
Stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper. Reheat gently without boiling.

notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge; freeze before adding the cream.
